releases.title: Faster test creation
notes: Teachers can paste questions copied from Word, WhatsApp, a PDF, Excel or an AI chat, and the app reads them.
Upload a CSV file from Excel, with a sample file to download.
Ask ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini to write the questions: the app prepares the request in the right format.

releases.title: Online tests
notes: Teachers can design multiple choice tests, set the time and marks, and publish them.
Students see each test as a card with the subject, time, marks and start time. The arrow opens once the test starts.
Students verify their details before the questions appear. Leaving the test screen erases the answers and the verification.
After submitting, students see which answers were correct. Parents see the same report, and teachers see every student's marks.

releases.title: Notifications and profile editing
notes: Notification bell on the student and parent dashboards. A blinking red dot means a new notice or update.
Edit your profile with the pencil icon. Parent changes are approved by the tuition office first.
Login Activity: delete one record, or clear them all.
Mother's name now shows in the child profile.

features.title: Notifications

features.title: Edit your child's profile

features.title: Edit your profile

features.title: Edit your profile

features.title: Profile requests
